item.title: Poll: Talarico has slim lead over Paxton in Texas Senate race
item.description: Three consecutive polls show Democrat James Talarico narrowly leading Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in the state's key Senate race.

item.title: Ohio, once a GOP stronghold, now poses a challenge for Republicans
item.description: Ohio, a reliably red state that helped propel President Trump's comeback and launch JD Vance, is now showing signs of political volatility.

item.title: Survey: Business students demand ethical AI use
item.description: A study from American University shows a sharp rise in AI usage among business students, from 6.2% to 29% in three years, with growing calls for ethical guidelines.

item.title: Renacci considers House run if Miller withdraws
item.description: Former Rep. Jim Renacci told Axios he may run for Congress again if Rep. Max Miller (R-Ohio) decides not to seek re-election.
